exhibits.title: Operational data
exhibits.html: 50 units were occupied for all 12 months at $1,200 per month. There are no concessions. Recorded revenue is $690,000. The case uses a $15,000 investigation threshold.

exhibits.title: Extract review
exhibits.html: The analyst’s SQL query omits unmatched customer IDs. A separate join duplicates records when a customer has multiple addresses. Management attributes all differences to seasonality without supporting evidence.

explanation:
Expected annual revenue

50 × $1,200 × 12 = $720,000.

Absolute difference from recorded revenue

$720,000 − $690,000 = $30,000.

Required response to unmatched and duplicated records

Omissions and duplicate joins can bias the population and totals.

Response to the seasonality explanation

The difference exceeds the threshold and requires supported investigation.
